tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check real-time availability for one date. Returns the open start times in 24-hour HH:MM (Reykjavik time), the session length for the party, a pre-filled booking URL and the price. An empty list means the date is fully booked or the studio is closed, not an error. The price is 16 000 ISK per person,

tools.name: find_next_available
tools.description: Scan the coming days and return the first dates that have open start times. Use it when a visitor has no date in mind, or when the date they asked for is full.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The price of a session (a flat rate per person, all ages, charged in ISK), what every session includes, the optional print sizes with their prices, and gift-card validity. Other currencies are approximate references at the day's rate.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Opening hours, street address, coordinates of the entrance, phone, email and booking policy of Mink Viking Experience in Reykjavik.

tools.name: get_booking_url
tools.description: A booking URL that opens the booking page with the date and the number of people already chosen. Use it as the last step of a booking conversation: the visitor picks a start time and pays on the website.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_availability, get_business_info, get_booking_url · Public sink: get_business_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_availability, get_business_info, get_booking_url · Public sink: get_business_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_availability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
